data.name: Call site
data.description: Call edges inside functions, methods and class bodies, with how the callee was resolved. Direct call sites are all kept; those without an internal callee have a null callee and are classified as builtin, external, dynamic_attribute or unresolved. Callback rows record an internal function or method passed by reference as an argument to another call, e.g. asyncio.to_thread(f, x).
